name: Ballad of Pain
source:
Junior-year college student Grimm has become extremely overwhelmed by the unfortunate circumstances of life. The pressure of a successful future and career, the hollow feeling of life slipping through her fingers, the everlasting feelings of loneliness - we all have our breaking points. 

Grimm has found herself in a purgatory- an almost dystopian version of the once rule-abiding universe she previously knew. Collapsed and crumbling buildings surrounded her while a blue-green, cloudy sky hovered above her. What was this metropolis-styled wasteland? A direct reflection of the rotted minds of all the victims in this purgatory. This world has no proper name other than Limbo.

[Edited from [url=https://tropikillerr.itch.io/ballad-of-pain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大三学生格林对不幸的生活处境感到极度不知所措。成功的未来和事业的压力、生命从指间溜走的空虚感、永恒的孤独感——我们都有自己的临界点。

格林发现自己身处炼狱——她以前所知道的曾经遵守规则的宇宙几乎是反乌托邦版本。倒塌和摇摇欲坠的建筑物包围着她，蓝绿色的多云天空盘旋在她的上方。这片都市风格的荒地是什么？直接反映了这个炼狱中所有受害者的腐烂思想。这个世界除了Limbo之外没有专有名称。

[编辑自[url=https://tropikillerr.itch.io/ballad-of-pain]itch.io[/url]]
